text:
ellie-sre: heads up, apiserver 503 spike in ap-south1 starting 02:17 UTC, controller-manager failing leader elections intermittently. kube-controller-manager logs show grpc disconnects to etcd leader.

oncall-bot: ALERT: apiserver_503_rate > 4.8% (ap-south1) — https://mon.redwood.example/alerts/9912 :rotating_light:

vijay-runtime: observed increased etcd raft election churn at 02:16: expected heartbeats missing; network counters show brief duplex errors on intercontrolplane NICs.

jess-provisioner: provisioning backlog: 40 GPU pods pending, many stuck in Terminating because webhook finalizer timeouts. halting new scaleups.

liam-net: we had a scheduled firmware rollout pushed to TopOfRack switches at 02:15 for asia rollout; vendor reported a 30s flapping session on a subset causing ARP storms. rolling back the firmware on impacted racks.

ellie-sre: logs snippet: ```
W0206 02:17:12.987654 1 watcher.go:121] watch terminated: rpc error: code = DeadlineExceeded desc = context deadline exceeded
E0206 02:17:13.123456 1 controller.go:88] leader election lost, error contacting etcd: rpc error: code = Unavailable desc = connection closed
etdctl: leader changed: node-3 -> node-1
```

vijay-runtime: workaround applied: bumping etcd client dial timeout to 15s and increasing lease renew interval for controller-manager. applying cluster-wide patch in kube-system.

jess-provisioner: paused GPU autoscaler for 20 minutes; added cost flag.

deploy-bot: rollback of ToR firmware completed at 02:22 UTC.

liam-net: creating NET-2020 for vendor follow-up + request to add health-check gating before future firmware pushes.

vijay-runtime: watch-gap alert suppressed for 10m while rolling restarts complete.

ellie-sre: after rollback, etcd election rate normalized, apiserver 503s reduced to 0.9%. verify dashboards: https://mon.redwood.example/d/controlplane/ap-south1

jess-provisioner: scheduled a reconciliation sweep for the Terminating pods to free finalizers once apiserver back.

ellie-sre: action items: (1) vendor postmortem + NET-2020, (2) add ToR firmware gating to release playbook, (3) add an early BGP/ARP anomaly detector upstream of controlplane health alerts.

vijay-runtime: will open PR to adjust default etcd client timeouts and document reasoning.

ellie-sre: thanks team. keep an eye for regressions in next 2h. :white_check_mark:
